_comment: Monolith-growth census baseline (DS-016). The shared rhiz-lint monolith-growth check (rhiz_growth engine, from rhizome tools-stable) reads this and bands charlotte's hand-grown source against the thresholds. `rhiz census` drills the bands. Scan is scoped to src/ (the source of truth); the root crawl.js / crawl-render.js are BUILD OUTPUTS generated from src/ by build.mjs and are excluded. The three files over threshold at adoption (2026-07-18) — src/report.js, src/crawl.js, src/report-templates/tracker-template.js — were all partitioned into ≤500-line modules via the build-roll-up modality (DS-002/DS-016) on 2026-07-19 (each kept alive as a thin facade/assembler; verified byte-identical build output on the golden fixtures). keep_whole is now empty: nothing is deliberately kept whole, and every src/ file is under threshold. The census remains a forward tripwire — add an entry here only to deliberately hold a future file whole, with its size-at-adoption and an honest reason.
